description: This bar chart, from the paper "SRPO Enhancing Multimodal LLM Reasoning via Reflection-Aware Reinforcement Learning," illustrates the number of samples collected for six distinct reasoning categories, with the vertical axis labeled "Number of Samples" and scaled logarithmically from 10² to 10⁴, and the horizontal axis listing the categories in descending order of sample count. The bars are all rendered in a uniform dark teal color and are labeled with their exact numerical values atop each bar. The category "Mathematical Reasoning" has the highest count at 7,025 samples, followed by "General Reasoning" at 1,709 samples. The subsequent categories, in descending order, are "Natural Scene Reasoning" with 413 samples, "Physical Reasoning" with 232 samples, "Logical Puzzle Reasoning" with 91 samples, and "Chemical Reasoning" with 49 samples. The bars are arranged in a single group, with no stacking or subgroups, and are sorted from left to right by their sample count in descending order, visually emphasizing the most frequent category on the far left.
